material_findings: Commit 940de5ab reports Together fine-tune run 4 job ft-343aff86-a5c1 launched, trained and evaluated after canonical authority 9.13 already set FREE_ONLY, Together forbidden and zero remaining paid allowance. Run 4 is therefore authority-violating historical diagnostic evidence only.
The same commit calls run 4 the fourth of five authorized runs and recommends a fifth run. Those phrases are stale non-authority and MUST NOT authorize run 5.

Run 4 exposed a real adapter-loading defect: safetensors keys contained an extra .language_model. segment, causing PEFT to report 48 missing LoRA tensors while load superficially succeeded. The commit states the same prefix affected run 3. This invalidates any assumption that prior local run-3 adapter evaluation necessarily exercised the intended LoRA weights unless independently re-bound and re-executed.

After key rewriting, run-4 fixed and broken loads produced byte-identical outputs on the reported eval sets. Therefore the new result does not demonstrate a useful adapter effect. On the newly generated 110-row HOLDOUT_FROZEN split, strong_full scored 0/30 while the three PRESERVE-yielding groups were perfect; the reused 10 novel scenarios remained 8/10.

The 10 reused novel scenarios already influenced bias-fix dataset design, so they are exploratory diagnosis for any successor, not confirmatory holdout evidence. The 110-row split is generator-related and cannot by itself establish Goodman-independent generalization.
Bootstrap-v2 output-containment closure from 9.13J remains source-only and runtime-unverified. Current owning VPS remains stale/dirty with no CONTROL_SYNC_REFRESH_PASS.
